text:
eli: opened PR to clarify the Console cost/latency pairing docs and add a tiny SDK snippet for sending trace keys with requests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4990

maya: Quick read2: wording looks good but the JS snippet uses `client.sendTrace()` which isn't in v1.0. suggest `client.attachTrace()` or show the raw header example.

oscar: I can add the raw header example: `headers['x-redwood-trace-id'] = trace.id` and a note about 0x prefix normalization.

eli: perfect. also added a short dashboard JSON that shows cost_by_model panel. worth noting import id collision warning.

maya: please add alt text to the screenshot and run linkcheck. I can upload the screenshot to /assets/images/docs/console-cost/ if assets-bot can't.

assets-bot: uploaded 1 file to /assets/images/docs/console-cost/panel-cost-by-model.png

doc-bot: CI lint: code fence language should be `json` not `js` for the panel snippet. linkcheck: 0 broken links.

oscar: fixed fences and pushed. added PromQL example: `sum(rate(console_unit_cost_total[5m])) by (model)` and a note about dividing by `sum(rate(token_count_total[5m]))` for per-token cost.

eli: all green here. merging after staging deploy. thanks team :rocket:
